name: Salvinorin A
effects: Extreme ego dissolution and perceptual distortion
Physical injury risk during 5-10 min peak — requires sitter and safe environment
Rapid tolerance development with repeated use

halfLifeEvidence.quote: After inhalation of 1 mg of vaporised salvinorin A by healthy volunteers, the drug was rapidly eliminated, with a t 1/2 varying from 49–50 min
halfLifeEvidence.identity: review titled 'Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Salvinorin A and Salvia divinorum'
halfLifeEvidence.note: Nonhuman-primate figures in the same review run 37.9-80.0 min; the 8 min figure is brain clearance in baboon, not plasma elimination.
